name: Youngstown
takeaway: Dynegy's Youngstown community page posts 9.97¢/kWh, fixed, June 2026 through June 2028. The city's opt-out letter documents the prior price, 7.99¢ through the June 2026 meter read. A second city document for 9.97¢ was not found, so the stored zone rate is still 7.99¢.
hook: Youngstown's Dynegy page shows 9.97¢ through June 2028. The city letter on file is 7.99¢ through June 2026. Read the bill before quoting either number.
notes: Dynegy program through June 2026 meter read. No confirmed successor program as of June 2026. Distinct from Mahoning County program (which covers unincorporated areas at different rate).

name: Trumbull County
takeaway: Trumbull County is stored as Dynegy Energy Services at 10.14¢/kWh from June 1, 2026 through December 1, 2027, prior price 7.9¢. The program excludes cities, villages, Brookfield, and Liberty.
hook: Trumbull County Dynegy is 10.14¢ through December 2027 on this record. Confirm the account is in the unincorporated county program.
notes: County program excludes cities/villages plus Brookfield and Liberty townships.

name: Mahoning County
takeaway: No countywide Mahoning aggregation rate is on file. Milton, Jackson, Springfield, Coitsville, Austintown, and other member townships carry their own programs. Ask which township the meter sits in.
hook: Mahoning County is not one aggregation. Name the township before quoting a price.
notes: No county-wide Dynegy program was found. Ask the commissioners' clerk whether the county certificate is active.

name: Warren City
takeaway: The zone file has 10.399¢/kWh and no supplier, with aggregation marked absent. NOPEC's community map and 2026 annual report list Warren as an electric member. A city notice of the current price was not in the sources checked on October 21, 2026.

notes: Surrounding Trumbull townships may have county aggregation.

name: Sebring

notes: 1005 Lake Park Blvd likely leans Ohio Edison but must be verified.

hook: Austintown is NOPEC, and the price on file is 8.99¢ through June 2027, not the 10.399¢ standard. Read the bill.
notes: NOPEC electric member. There is no Mahoning County Dynegy program.

takeaway: Campbell has no aggregation price on file. It sits on Ohio Edison next to Youngstown and is separate from any township program.

Ohio Edison territory. Steel/industrial/commercial character. High C&I density relative to population.

name: Springfield Township (Mahoning)
takeaway: Springfield Township (Mahoning) is on the NOPEC standard program at 10.399¢/kWh, variable, from the September 2026 meter read through the June 2027 meter read. No early termination fee. The prior standard price was 9.999¢ for the June through August 2026 meter reads. Eligible residential and small-business accounts are enrolled unless they opted out or chose a fixed term (12-month 10.299¢, 24-month 10.599¢). Larger mercantile accounts are outside the aggregation.
hook: Springfield Township (Mahoning) small accounts on the NOPEC default are at 10.399¢ through the June 2027 meter read, no exit fee, up from 9.999¢. Ask whether the larger meters opted out.
notes: NOPEC standard 10.399¢/kWh variable, September 2026 through June 2027 meter reads, no exit fee. Prior standard price 9.999¢ for June through August 2026 meter reads. NOPEC electric member. There is no Mahoning County Dynegy program.
